worldcombat.skill.firepunch.summary: A fist wreathed in flame strikes the first target along the aim direction: it deals damage and has a good chance to set the target burning (a damage-over-time that also weakens its physical attacks); if it catches, the fire then spreads to the nearest other foe that is not already burning and can be lit. A fire-immune or already-burning foe in between does not swallow the spread.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.use.0: Set a target alight at close range for lasting damage
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.use.1: Use the burn to weaken the target's physical attacks
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.use.2: Let the fire spread to a second foe beside the target
The punch deals %1$s contact and punch damage over a fixed reach of about %2$s blocks; it never stretches for a target that runs, and walls or other bodies block it.

On a hit there is a %1$s chance to set the target burning for %2$s; while burning it loses about 1/16 of its max health (at least 1) every 5 seconds and deals half physical damage (targets immune to burning, such as Fire types, are unaffected).

If the target is burning (whether this punch set it alight or it was already burning), the flames search from the target outward within %1$s blocks by real distance for the nearest foe that is not already burning and can be lit, burning it for %2$s; already-burning, immune or line-of-sight-blocked targets are skipped, so one in between does not swallow the spread.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.blazeUp.on: Blaze: a higher burn chance, a longer burn and a farther spread, but a lighter punch and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.blazeUp.off: Kindling: a heavier punch and a faster cycle, but a harder burn and a shorter spread.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s and the burn chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.preference.b: On: burn chance +15%%, burn duration x1.15, spread range x1.25, but punch power x0.88 and cooldown +5 ticks, for laying fire. Off (kindling): a heavier punch and a faster cycle, but a harder burn and a shorter spread.
worldcombat.skill.firepunch.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The fire punch reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets not already burning rank first, so the fire seed is not wasted; off: all targets score the same.
